articles.title: 2 ex-Arsenal defenders agree about Ezri Konsa
articles.summary: Former Arsenal defenders Steph Houghton and Martin Keown have praised Ezri Konsa’s start with the club and his new partnership with Gabriel Magalhaes.Photo b...
articles.body:
Former Arsenal defenders Steph Houghton and Martin Keown have praised Ezri Konsa's start with the club and his new partnership with Gabriel Magalhaes.

Arsenal kept their eighth clean sheet of the season on Saturday, and a big reason for the team's defensive success so far has been the addition of summer signing Ezri Konsa .

The Gunners were obviously in a tricky situation going into the new campaign, knowing that William Saliba wouldn't be available before November, if not even later.

Saliba has been widely touted as one of the world's best centre-backs for a few years now, so adequately replacing him seemed almost impossible. But Konsa has really stepped up to the task.

Speaking on Match of the Day on Saturday night, former Arsenal and Manchester City defender Steph Houghton suggested Konsa's new partnership with Gabriel Magalhaes is proving to be one of the best around.

"In terms of Premier League experience, international experience, coming off the back of a really good World Cup, I think you can see that he is full of confidence," Houghton said .

"When you've got an opportunity, when Saliba's injured, he's really, really taken that. I think in terms of that partnership that he's building with Gabriel, it's really hard to look any further than those two in the Premier League at this moment in time."

Martin Keown agreed, emphasising just how high the expectations are at Arsenal at the moment.

"Two of them (Gabriel and Saliba) were on the Ballon d'Or list of the best defenders in world football," Keown added. "So, you know, you're putting it on the line, and he's come in and he's not been overshadowed at all by the people he's played alongside."

There will be another big test next week, as Konsa travels with Arsenal away to Anfield. Keeping a clean sheet away to Liverpool is arguably the Gunners' biggest Premier League test yet.

articles.title: Injured Real Madrid defender to travel to Barcelona to support teammates in El Clasico
articles.summary: Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio has decided to travel to Barcelona to support his teammates ahead of Sunday’s El Clasico, despite being ruled out of the cr...
articles.body:
Real Madrid defender Raul Asencio has decided to travel to Barcelona to support his teammates ahead of Sunday's El Clasico, despite being ruled out of the crucial meeting through injury.

According to a report from AS , the centre-back does not want to miss the occasion and intends to be with the squad as Los Blancos prepare for one of their biggest fixtures of the season at Camp Nou.

Asencio will be unavailable on the pitch, but his decision to make the trip shows his desire to support the team during a demanding moment in the campaign.

Asencio travels to Barcelona to back Real Madrid teammates

With Real Madrid preparing to face Barcelona without him, Asencio has chosen to show his support in person rather than watch the contest from a distance.

The defender's presence is intended to help rally his teammates before a match in which every contribution could matter.

Raul Asencio will support his teammates in Barcelona. (Photo by Angel Martinez/Getty Images)

His absence is an unfortunate setback, particularly given that he had been in line to make his first appearance of the season after the most recent international break.

Instead, Real Madrid must manage the defensive situation without him for the Clasico.

The timing is frustrating for Asencio, who will have to watch one of the campaign's most important matches from the sidelines.

However, travelling to Barcelona gives him the chance to remain close to the group and offer support away from the pitch.

Real Madrid defender targets December return

While missing the Clasico, Asencio is continuing to work towards his return, with his recovery progressing well.

Asencio is hoping to make his comeback in December. (Photo by Jose Manuel Alvarez Rey/Getty Images)

As such, the defender is seeking to shorten his recovery timeline and has set his sights on returning for Real Madrid 's first Copa del Rey match of the season.

That fixture is expected to take place on December 16, although the date remains subject to confirmation.

Asencio understands that returning within roughly three months will be difficult, but he is aiming to be available for the cup opener.

His recovery will depend on how his condition develops, meaning the target should be viewed as an ambition rather than a guaranteed comeback date.

articles.title: Amorim eyes raid on Manchester United for £52m defender
articles.summary: Ruben Amorim is keen on a reunion with Manchester United defender Leny Yoro at AC Milan.The Serie A side are weighing up a move for the 20-year-old at the en...
articles.body:
Ruben Amorim is keen on a reunion with Manchester United defender Leny Yoro at AC Milan.

The Serie A side are weighing up a move for the 20-year-old at the end of the season, according to reports in Italy. Calciomercato claim Yoro is on the wish-list for Milan next summer, as Amorim eyes a raid on his former club.

Yoro signed for Manchester United from Lille in a £52m deal in 2024, beating Real Madrid to his signature. Yoro was viewed as one of the most promising defenders in Europe at that time, but has failed to develop as hoped.

He was used out-of-position at right-back during the recent draw at Leeds United, and has already worked under three different managers. Milan are considering whether a deal can be done, with Amorim earmarking the Frenchman as an option for his back-three system.

Former France midfielder Emmanuel Petit recently questioned whether Yoro is in the right environment to improve.

"He's had spells when he's injured and sometimes he's playing at right-back and sometimes he's playing at centre-back," he said.

"When you look at the lack of stability of the club he's playing for and the lack of confidence around the group, is it Leny Yoro's responsibility to raise his level when you see other players who are also not playing at a high level?

"There are leaders missing at Manchester United. I don't like Bruno Fernandes body language. I've not liked it this season and I didn't like it last season.

"This year's started very slowly for Manchester United and Leny Yoro can't solve all the problems at the club."
